theorems.name: Submission.tgc_eventual_density_bounds_uniform
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (F G : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), 0 < β → (∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ F t) → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), G t ≤ ε * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n) → ∃ m k : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) * t ^ n) ≤ F t ∧ G t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) * β * t ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
